import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(label, request, evidence, policy, expected):
    original=copy.deepcopy((request,evidence,policy))
    actual=evaluate(request,evidence,policy)
    assert actual == expected, (label,actual,expected)
    assert (request,evidence,policy) == original, (label,'inputs modified')
    assert list(actual) == ['status','value','sources','unknowns'], (label,list(actual))

# Independently constructed boundary probes for Stage 3.
check('sorted missing', {'claim':'q','conditions':{'b':2}}, [], {'required_conditions':['z','a']}, {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
check('absent calibration', {'claim':'q','conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':0}}, [{'source':'absent','claim':'q','value':7,'conditions':{'mode':'m'},'verified':True},{'source':'zero','claim':'q','value':7,'conditions':{'mode':'m','calibration':0},'verified':True}], {'required_conditions':['mode','calibration'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['zero'],'unknowns':[]})
check('eligible superseder only', {'claim':'q','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'old','claim':'q','value':'old','conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'q','value':'new','conditions':{'x':1},'verified':False,'supersedes':['old']}], {'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}, {'status':'supported','value':'old','sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})
check('source count no authority', {'claim':'q','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'a','claim':'q','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1}},{'source':'b','claim':'q','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1}},{'source':'c','claim':'q','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1}}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','c'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check('false agreement', {'claim':'q','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'b','claim':'q','value':False,'conditions':{'x':1}},{'source':'a','claim':'q','value':False,'conditions':{'x':1}}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
check('self supersession is not other', {'claim':'q','conditions':{'x':1}}, [{'source':'self','claim':'q','value':3,'conditions':{'x':1},'supersedes':['self']}], {'required_conditions':['x']}, {'status':'supported','value':3,'sources':['self'],'unknowns':[]})
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
required=set(schema['required'])
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
actual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
assert actual == report, (actual,report)
assert all(set(item)==required for item in report)
print('6 independent boundary probes and report/schema checks passed')
